_note: Every number here is a PLACEHOLDER - tune freely. The map is data/map.txt.

effects._note: Every potion is for the hero and their gear. heal: HP back. ward: a shield enchantment that soaks up this much damage. venom: the weapon is coated for this many hits; each hit poisons. Poison: the enemy loses its poison in HP every tick, then poison goes down by 1.

ingredients._note: One ingredient alone, or any mix that isn't a recipe, is an UNNAMED potion: just the ingredients' effects added up.

recipes._note: Exactly these ingredients, any order. Strength against ONE ingredient: a 2-ingredient recipe about x3, a 3-ingredient recipe about x5. known = in the book at the start. Brewing one you don't know still works and puts it in the book; winning a fight teaches one more.

realtime._note: No ingredients arrive on their own: you start with a full hand and REDRAW (replace your hand) whenever its meter is full.

turns._note: Your turn: put one ingredient (parts_per_turn) in the flask, hand over a potion if you like, then END TURN. Walking, each tile is a turn. The hero attacks (an enemy that chose BLOCK stops the first hit), then the enemy does what it showed (the hero always blocks: hits land at hero_block). Poison ticks once a turn, before the enemy acts.

fresh._note: The flask (and the potion brewed from it, until it's used) is full strength on the turn an ingredient goes in and for full_turns turns after; then it loses per_turn each turn (by ingredient count: 1, 2, 3), down to nothing. Adding an ingredient makes it full again. Real time counts a turn as turn_secs seconds.

walk._note: Between fights the hero walks the path: realtime at tiles_per_sec; turns one tile every beat (each tile is a turn).
